asr.full_text: Welcome to the Guide. If you have been looking for a definitive no-nonsense walkthrough on how to get started with Binance, you are in exactly the right place. Today I am going to walk you through the absolute simplest and most efficient way to navigate the worlds' largest cryptocurrency exchange. To begin, let's look at the first step signing up you'll want to go ahead and click the link I've placed in the description or the pinned comment section right below this video that link is your direct path to the official finance signup screen now it's worth noting that if you access the platform through that specific link you're actually going to receive a 50% fee payback along with a $600 rewards package simultaneously. It's a significant advantage for any new trader. Once you've landed on the page, let's get that account created.. Again simply click the link below the video. You can choose to either sign sign up using your email address or your mobile phone. Go ahead and enter the email you'd like to use, and just take a quick second to check the terms and conditions agreement at the bottom. Once that's all done, click continue. At this point a 6 digit verification code will be sent immediately to the email or phone you just provided. Simply retrieve that code and enter it into the boxes. Click continue, next you'll need to set your password. For your security this must be at least eight characters long and include at least one number and one uppercase letter. And just like that your account creation is officially complete. If an Inviter Code screen pops up, just ensure the code is active and finalize your signup. Now that your account is ready, we need to move on to a very important step. KYC Identity Verification. This is a requirement you must complete to unlock the ability to default, withdraw and start trading on the Binance platform. Because this process involves a live facial scan, we are going to continue the next steps right on your mobile phone for a much smoother experience. Go ahead and install and launch the Binance App on your smartphone. When you log in with your new account the app will usually take you straight to the verification screen. First you'll confirm your nationality and then select the ID card you'd like to be using. Whether you choose a national ID a driver's license or your passport, the review is generally processed within about five minutes so basically just go with whichever document is most convenient for you. Select Take Pictures as your submission method and click Continue. You will want to take a clear, well lit photo of the front and back of your ID making sure it fits perfectly within the camera frame. Next, just position your face inside the oval frame on the screen and follow the prompts. Once the facial scan is finished, you'll just need to confirm your additional info like your name, birthdate, and address, then click Continue From there, select your occupation, click Continue, and lastly pick your industry and click Continue one last time The review typically takes about five minutes and you can verify your status right on your profile screen. With your identity verified our final step is to lock down your account security with Two-Factor Authentication or 2FA. For this part let's head back over to your PC screen. In the left-hand menu under account go ahead and click on security thenWPC screen. In the left hand menu, under account, go ahead and click on Security, then click manage right next to the authenticator app option. When you click enable authenticator app, a verification code will be sent to your email or phone just to verify it's really you. Enter that code in a QR code window will appear. Just leave that screen up for a moment. And let's go to your phone to download the Google authenticator app. once the installation is done, open the app. Tap. Get started, come in clicking use without signing in, then just tap, add a code and select scan a QR code, point your phone at the PC screen to scan that code and a 6 digit OTP for Binance will be generated instantly. Now go back to Binance on your computer Click Next. Enter those 6 digits from your app and hit Submit Your Google OTP is now officially activated and your account is secure Let's dive into the mechanics of fueling your account through P2P trading. This remains a premiere method for acquiring crypto instantly. On the Binance dashboard, locate the small wallet symbol in the upper right and select spot From that menu, hit the deposit button and choose P2P trading Review it, then click the got it button Inside the P2P trading. Review it, then click the Got It button. Inside the P2P interface, verify you are viewing the Buy section. I strictly suggest picking USDT as your target asset. USDT acts as a stable coin which means it's value is tied to the US Dollar. This provides a much steadier foundation for your capital compared to the volatility of buying Bitcoin first. Input the volume of local cash you wish to commit. Pick your ideal payment channel and a gallery of merchants will appear. Safety is paramount! Prioritize vendors boasting a massive volume of successful swaps and high satisfaction percentages. When you spot a solid partner, hit BUYUSDT, review the merchant's specific transfer rules thoroughly, this is vital. Re-enter your amount, double check the terms, and hit BUYUSDT once more. The merchants banking data will now be visible. Execute the transfer through your banking application, then return to Binance and hit Transferred notify seller. You should attach a digital receipt as evidence, tick the consent box and hit confirm. In a few minutes the merchant unlocks the coins and they will land in your spot wallet. Now that USDT is sitting in your spot wallet, you are prepared for futures trading. However, before engaging with contracts, we must shift those funds to the correct partition. Navigate back to that wallet symbol and enter SPOT. Hit the Transfer button. In the dialogue box, toggle the From Field to Spot and the To Field to USDS-M Futures. Ensure USDT is the selected asset, input the quantity you want to allocate for trades, and hit Confirm. Boom, your collateral is moved and you are ready for the big leagues. It is time to launch into futures trading for real. In the main header, hover over Futures and select usd-m futures. This action triggers the Primary trading desk, which might look complex initially but we will simplify it. In the top left corner, you can tap the active pair to browse and pick the specific token you want to speculate on. On the right side, you will find the control panel to configure your trade. Your first priority is verifying the margin mode. You will encounter Cros and IsoLated. Crossmargin utilizes your entire futures account to support a trade, whereas Isolated margine restricts the risk to only the specific funds assigned to that single position. For those just starting, I strongly advocate for Isolated mode as it provides superior risk containment. Next door is your Leverage setting, you can crank this 150 times but tread carefully. Massive Leverage allows you to command a giant position with tiny capital, but you can also be liquidated instantly if the market dips against you. You also have a new opportunity to invest in the second tier of a game. and the trade only activates if the market reaches that mark. Conversely, a market order fires off immediately at the best available current rate Once you have picked your type, check your available margin and define the quantity for the trade. Now, determine your direction. If you anticipate the token's value will rise, hit long. If you expect the price to drop, hit short. Once your trade is active, monitor it via the position's row at the bottom. So here are the breakdowns of these metrics. Entry Price Your starting point Mark price, the current, global market value Liquidation Price Kill Switch If the token hits this mark, your position is force closed to stop further debt. your real-time gain or loss. To safeguard your capital, hit the edit icon near tp slash sl to define your take profit and stop loss boundaries. This ensures the engine automatically exits your trade at a gain or a pre predetermined exit point. To manually exit everything, just hit market or limit under the close all tab. And that is it. The trade is finished. That concludes our full tutorial on navigating and trading futures on Binance. I trust this walkthrough simplified the journey for you. If you found this guide helpful and easy to digest, please do us a massive favor and drop a like.
